neighbouring_scope.note: Grades 1/2 introduce number representations, addition/subtraction to 100, the small multiplication table and inverse division. Grade 4 extends these foundations with place-value bundles and mental/halfwritten strategies. Negative numbers, other number systems, numbers above one million and Grade 5 term rules remain outside this batch. Written algorithms and full annual coverage remain incomplete.
